spans.s: भंकारी f. A gadfly.
भंकारी f. A gadfly.
भंक्ति f. Breaking, fracture.

भंग m. 1. Splitting, shattering, dividing, वार्यर्गलाभंग इव प्रवृत्तः R.v.45; 2. a break, a breach, a fracture; 3. chasm, division; 4. breaking to pieces, separation analysis; 5. a piece, a fragment, करेणुभिर्दत्तमृणालभंगाः R.xvi.16; 6. fall, ruin, destruction, decay; 7. failure, frustration, R.ii.42; 8. defeat, overthrow, humiliation; 9. interruption, impediment, non-performance; 10. rejection, refusal; 11. taking to flight, flight; 12. going, motion; 13. a bend, a fold, a wave; 14. paralysis; 15. fraud, falsehood; 16. a watercourse, a canal; 17. a roundabout mode of acting or speaking.
भंगा f. 1. Hemp; 2. an intoxicating beverage prepared from hemp.
भांग a. (f. गी) Made of hemp, hempen.
भंग-नय m. removal of obstacles.
भंग-वासा f. turmeric.
भंग-सार्थ a. fraudulent, dishonest.
भंगा-कट n. the pollen of hemp.

भंगि f. 1. Fracture, breach, division; 2. bending, undulation; 3. a wave; 4. a current; 5. a crooked path, tortuous course; 6. a roundabout mode of acting or speaking, circumlocution, तत् पर्यायेण भंग्यंतरेण कथनात् पर्यायोक्तम् K.Pr.x.; 7. irony, repartee; 8. semblance, pretext, trick, fraud, यः पांचजन्यप्रतिबिंबभंग्या धारांभसः फेनमिव व्यनक्ति Vikr.Ch.i.1; 9. a step, मार्गेण भंगिरचितस्फटिकेन रामः R.xiii.69; 10. modesty; 11. interval.

भंगि f. 1. Fracture, breach, division; 2. bending, undulation; 3. a wave; 4. a current; 5. a crooked path, tortuous course; 6. a roundabout mode of acting or speaking, circumlocution, तत् पर्यायेण भंग्यंतरेण कथनात् पर्यायोक्तम् K.Pr.x.; 7. irony, repartee; 8. semblance, pretext, trick, fraud, यः पांचजन्यप्रतिबिंबभंग्या धारांभसः फेनमिव व्यनक्ति Vikr.Ch.i.1; 9. a step, मार्गेण भंगिरचितस्फटिकेन रामः R.xiii.69; 10. modesty; 11. interval.
भांग a. (f. गी) Made of hemp, hempen.
भंगि-भक्ति f. division Into waves or wavelike steps, a staircase, Megh.i.60.
भंगि-भक्ति f. division Into waves or wavelike steps, a staircase, Megh.i.60.
भंगिन् a. (f. नी) Fragile, transient, perishable, तदपि तत्क्षणभम्गि करोति चेत् Bhartr.ii.92.
भंगिन् a. (f. नी) Fragile, transient, perishable, तदपि तत्क्षणभम्गि करोति चेत् Bhartr.ii.92.
भंगिमन् m. 1. Fracture, breach; 2. curliness; 3. perversity, foolishness; 4. disguise, deceit; 5. irony.
भंगील n. Defect in the organs of sense.

भंगुर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Fragile, brittle; 2. frail, transitory, perishable, स्वेच्छाभंगुरभाग्यमेघतडितः शक्या न रोद्धुं श्रियः Vikr.Ch.xviii.106; 3. crooked, bent, wrinkled, curled; 4. fraudulent, dishonest.
भंगुर (II) m. A bend of a river.

भंगुर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Fragile, brittle; 2. frail, transitory, perishable, स्वेच्छाभंगुरभाग्यमेघतडितः शक्या न रोद्धुं श्रियः Vikr.Ch.xviii.106; 3. crooked, bent, wrinkled, curled; 4. fraudulent, dishonest.

भंज् vt. 7P (pp. भग्न; pres. भनक्ति; desid. बिभङ्क्षति) 1. To split, to break, to shatter, बभंजुर्वलयानि चैव Bt.iii.22, धनुरभाजियत्त्वया R.xi.76; 2. to commit waste, भनक्त्युपवनं कपिः Bt.ix.2; 3. to make a breach; 4. to interrupt, to arrest, to suspend, to frustrate; 5. to disappoint, पिनाकिना भग्नमनोरथा सती K.S.v.1.With प्र-, 1. to break, to shatter; 2. to arrest, to suspend; 3. to disappoint.
भंजक a. (f. जिका) Who or what breaks or divides.
भंजक a. (f. जिका) Who or what breaks or divides.
भंजन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Breaking; 2. arresting, frustrating; 3. causing violent pain.
भंजन (II) m. Decay of the teeth.
भंजन (III) n. 1. Destroying, shattering; 2. routing; 3. afflicting; 4. interrupting, frustrating; 5. removing, dispelling, तदुदितभयभंजनाय यूनां त्वदधरसीधुसुधैव सिद्धमंत्रः Git.G.x.
भंजन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Breaking; 2. arresting, frustrating; 3. causing violent pain.
भंजनक m. A particular disease of the mouth.
भंजरु m. A tree growing near a temple.
भंड m. A jester, a buffoon, an actor, e.g. त्रयो वेदस्य कर्तारो भंडधूर्तनिशाचराः.
भांड (I) m. pl. Merchandise.

भांड (II) n. 1. A vessel, a pot, a utensil, M.iv.65, v.112; 2. a chest, a box, a case; 3. an implement, a tool; 4. a musical instrument; 5. a bale of goods; 6. the stock of a shopkeeper, merchandise; (hence ‘any valued possession,’ अथ नु रिपुरकस्माद्वेष्टि नः पुत्रभांडे Mv.ii.); 7. horse-trappings, harness; 8. the bed of a river; 9. buffoonery, (from भंड).
भंड-हासिनी f. a harlot, a prostitute.
भंडक m. A wagtail.
भांडक (I) m.n. A small vessel, a cup.
भांडक (II) n. Goods, merchandise.
भंडन n. 1. Armour, mail; 2. war, battle; 3. wickedness, mischief.
भंडि(डी) f. A wave.
भंडि(डी) f. A wave.
भांडि f. A razor-case.
भंडिल (I) a. (f. ला) Fortunate, happy, auspicious.
भंडिल (II) m. 1. Fortune, welfare; 2. a messenger; 3. an artizan.
भंडिल (I) a. (f. ला) Fortunate, happy, auspicious.
भांडिक m. A barber.
भंदिल n. 1. Prosperity; 2. tremulous motion.
भंभ m. 1. A fly; 2. smoke.
भंभरालिका f. A gadfly.
भंभरालिका f. A gadfly.
भंभारव m. The lowing of a cow.
भा-कोष, -नेमि m. the sun.
भा-निकर m. a multitude of rays, a mass of light.
भांगक m. A ragged cloth.
भांगीन n. A field of hemp.
भांड-अगार, -आगार m.n. 1. a store-room, a treasury; 2. a place where household utensils are kept.
भांड-अगार, -आगार m.n. 1. a store-room, a treasury; 2. a place where household utensils are kept.
भांड-पति m. a merchant.
भांड-पुट m. a barber.
भांड-प्रतिभांडक n. computation of the exchange of goods (in math.).
भांड-मूल्य n. capital consisting of wares.
भांड-शाला f. a store-room.
भांडार n. A storehouse.
भांडारिन् f. The keeper of a storehouse.
भांडि-वाह m. a barber.
भांडि-शाला f. a barber’s shop.
भांडिक m. A barber.
भांडिका f. An implement, a tool.
भांडिनी f. A chest, a basket.
भांडीर m. The Indian fig tree.
भान n. 1. The act of growing visible; 2. light, lustre; 3. perception, knowledge.

भानु (I) m. 1. Light, lustre, brightness; 2. a ray of light, जालांतरगते भानौ यत्सूक्ष्मं दृश्यते रजः M.viii.132; 3. the sun, यावदत्येति भानुः Megh.i.34, Sis.i.27; 4. beauty; 5. a day; 6. a king, a prince; 7. an epithet of Śiva.
भानु (II) f. A handsome woman.
भानु-केशर, -केसर m. the sun.
भानु-केशर, -केसर m. the sun.
भानु-ज m. the planet Saturn.
भानु-दिन n. Sunday.
भानु-वार m. Sunday.
भानु-मत् (I) a. 1. luminous, splendid; 2. beautiful, handsome.
भानु-मत् (II) m. the sun, K.S.iii.65, R.vi.36.
